M6.L1.title: Use metric measurement to model the decomposition of one whole into tenths.

M6.L2.title: Use metric measurement and area models to represent tenths as fractions greater than 1 and decimal numbers.

M6.L3.title: Represent mixed numbers with units of tens, ones, and tenths with place value disks, on the number line, and in expanded notation.

M6.L4.title: Use meters to model the decomposition of one whole into hundredths. Represent and count hundredths.

M6.L5.title: Model the equivalence of tenths and hundredths using the area model and place value disks.

M6.L6.title: Use the area model and number line to represent mixed numbers with units of ones, tenths, and hundredths in fraction and decimal forms.

M6.L7.title: Model mixed numbers with units of hundreds, tens, ones, tenths, and hundredths in expanded notation and on the place value chart.

M6.L8.title: Use understanding of fraction equivalence to investigate decimal numbers on the place value chart expressed in different units.

M6.L9.title: Use the place value chart and metric measurement to compare decimals and answer comparison questions.

M6.L10.title: Use area models and the number line to compare decimal numbers, and record comparisons using < , > , and = .

M6.L11.title: Compare and order mixed numbers in various forms.

M6.L12.title: Apply place value understanding to add tenths and hundredths.

M6.L13.title: Apply place value understanding to subtract tenths and hundredths.

M6.L14.title: Solve word problems involving the addition and subtraction of measurements in decimal form.

M6.L15.title: Express money amounts given in various forms as decimal numbers.

M6.L16.title: Understand the purpose of financial institutions and advantages and disadvantages of savings options.

M6.L17.title: Understand the difference between fixed and variable expenses for the purpose of allocating a weekly allowance.

M6.L18.title: Solve word problems including the calculation of profit.
